rules.reason: These boss-drop accessories provide offensive, defensive, debuff-immunity, summon, or combat-mobility effects through custom UpdateAccessory logic and MyPlayer flags. The snapshot exports their acquisition paths but cannot represent those arbitrary or conditional effects in classEffects, so explicit all-class combat classification is required.
